description: Valid https URL returns 201 with code and target; GET metadata returns 200 with createdAt/expiresAt
Missing, malformed or past-expiry create returns 400; unknown code metadata returns 404
GET /r/{code} and legacy /{code} return 302 with Location equal to target
Queue capacity 1 with many redirects still returns 302 every time
After 3 redirects analytics eventually reports totalClicks 3
Unknown analytics 404; 404 and 410 redirects are not counted
Public https host not on blocklist is accepted with 201
ftp, javascript, file schemes and credentials URLs return 400
Blocklisted host and its subdomain return 400
After expiry redirect returns 410 and metadata is 200 with isExpired true
Creation over limit returns 429 with Retry-After
Requests within limit succeed and another client is unaffected by throttling
Redirect over configured limit returns 429 with Retry-After
